datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2015, classifying geographic areas in Uganda by food insecurity phase. The data represents near-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions aggregated at the sub-national level, with multiple scenarios captured for January, April, July, and October 2015.
